race.description: Road To Magic Millions Book Now Qtis 3yo Mdn Hcp
race.comment: FRACUS (3) can get off the mark fourth-up after closing off strongly to just miss at Eagle Farm as favourite. Has been kept fresh with 35 days between runs and is drawn to be blending in at the right time. VICE ROYAL (7) has left himself with too much ground to bridge in his first two starts but has been warming late, especially last time here when a real eyecatcher. The Gollan-Maloney combination always adds confidence. Looks the main danger. DRIVE TO ZOUVIVE (11) was third first-up at this track after blundering at the start, and any natural second-up improvement puts her right in the mix. Thompson's booking is also worth noting. SPIRIT FALLS (12) was much better second-up at Eagle Farm when relishing the testing conditions, ripping home into second in what has proven a strong form reference. Deserves a lot more respect third-up.
